quote.summary: RoboTechnik Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company primarily engaged in providing manufacturing equipment and systems for photovoltaic industry and silicon photonics industry. The Company mainly offers two businesses: photovoltaic manufacturing solutions and silicon photonics assembly and testing equipment. Photovoltaic manufacturing solutions include manufacturing equipment (including automation and process equipment) for photovoltaic cell and module manufacturing, large-scale complete production lines, and intelligent manufacturing systems. The silicon photonics assembly and testing equipment business manufactures process control master (PCM) master units for advanced silicon photonic devices, controlling micro-assembly and testing equipment, serving the semiconductor and photonics industries. The Company operates in the domestic and overseas markets.
